name: L1 Shearlet Regularized CT Reconstruction (ADMM)
definition: Reconstruction algorithm solving the l1 shearlet regularized CT problem: arg min_f (kSH(f)||1,w + 1/2 ||Rf - y||2^2) subject to f >= 0, using ADMM.
summary: L1 Shearlet Regularized CT Reconstruction (ADMM) solves CT reconstruction by enforcing shearlet sparsity and non-negativity via ADMM, handling limited-angle artifacts better than filtered backprojection.
